card.name: Linking words before CNS side-effect lists
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'of', 'as' and 'cause' right before a list of side effects in drug-interaction warnings, especially CNS depression, sedation and respiratory depression. Also fires on a digit in a phone number.

modes.label: Link before effect list
modes.description: 'of', 'as' or 'cause' just before sedation-type adverse effects in interaction text.
modes.example: can increase the risk<< of>> hypotension, respiratory depression, profound

modes.label: Such as before side effects
modes.description: 'as' after 'side effects such' introducing a list of symptoms.
modes.example: This may produce carbamazepine side effects such<< as>> diplopia, headache, atax

modes.label: Phone number digit
modes.description: A digit inside a toll-free reporting phone number.
modes.example: at www.PhenTopREMS.com or by telephone at 1-800-2<<6>>9-6816 or by
